halls._note: Passenger space today and with the project. Sourced: shop areas, passengers, the Gare du Nord roofs (see sources.json). Assumptions: the covered halls kept at Gare du Nord, Gare de Lyon (Hall 1, as far as Hall 2) and Montparnasse are each about 150 m long from the street end, with about 30 m used today for waiting and the rest by the ends of the tracks (estimate from the SNCF station plans); widths from the number of tracks under each hall on those plans, at 6.5 m per track with its share of platform; one mezzanine across each deep station, 30 m deep, as wide as the tracks at the width per track of Magenta (13.5 m).
